summary_en: MODEC initiated a share buyback program to acquire up to 2.0 million shares (2.9% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥10.0 billion through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 to January 29, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on February 18, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, MODEC's board of directors resolved to initiate a treasury stock acquisition program. The company will acquire up to 2.0 million ordinary shares, representing 2.9% of outstanding shares (68,344,249 shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum total consideration of ¥10.0 billion. Acquisitions will be conducted through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 11, 2026 and January 29, 2027.

All shares acquired under this program will be cancelled on February 18, 2027. The board stated that the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. The specific acquisition price has not been predetermined; purchases will be made at market prices during the designated acquisition period.
